channel.provenance_note: The owned Senate homepage designates its ordinary Senate video channel, separate from the Constituent Convention channel. Its 15 October 2026 report of the 27th ordinary sitting directly embeds the Alejandra Navarro municipal-charter and Juan Cruz Curá C14/C15 railway speeches. Both source clips decode and advance from 30 to 31 seconds in process-muted Chromium; inspected images show actual chamber-floor debate and a senator addressing the chamber. These are two short segments of one sitting, not two meeting dates or full-session validation.
